strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for a liquidity grab where price breaks support or resistance in a fakeout and then marks the candle that made the grab as the entry point. The direction depends on whether the grab is below support for a long or above resistance for a short.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent swing high for longs or recent swing low for shorts. The speaker frames this as a reversal trade with a small stop and a large risk-reward target.

variants.timeframe_note: 15-minute examples shown, with the indicator auto-marking the setup
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter when the indicator gives the reversal signal after the liquidity grab candle
variants.target_note: recent high for longs / recent low for shorts
variants.transcript_quote: the indicator marks the liquidity grab for us it starts to Mark the entry point and the signal to enter

variants.variant_label: higher-timeframe context filter for reversal entries
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: only take the liquidity-grab reversal when the lower-timeframe signal occurs at higher-timeframe support or resistance
variants.target_note: same recent swing high/low target as the base setup
variants.transcript_quote: we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame
